setup.text: Phish or Fine? Buzzer Battle. Two players per heat race to call each message Phish, a scam, or Fine, safe. Left player: A for phish, S for fine. Right player: K for phish, L for fine. Or just tap. First right answer scores 100, a wrong buzz costs 50, and three in a row multiplies your points. Type the player names, then press Start battle.

next-heat.text: Get ready: left player uses A and S, right player uses K and L. Tap Start heat when you are both set.

champ.text: Tap See leaderboard for the final scores.

board.text: That is the final leaderboard. Tap Shield debrief to see what each player lost on.

debrief.text: Shield debrief. Here is what each player should practice next.

first.text: First move: read the message, then buzz Phish if it is a scam, or Fine if it is safe. Fastest right answer wins!

snip-u1.text: A text from an unknown number. Northbridge Security: your account will be DELETED in 30 minutes unless you verify now at nb-verify.co/now

snip-u2.text: An email from cfo.office@northbridge-finance.net. Boarding in 10 min. Wire the vendor $7,200 before I land and do not loop anyone else in.

snip-u3.text: A chat message from Priya Shah (your team, northbridge.co). Reminder: timesheets are due by 5 today. Submit them in the HR portal from your bookmark like usual.

snip-d1.text: An email from it-help@northbrigde.co. Your mailbox is 99% full. Click here within 24 hours to keep your messages.

snip-d2.text: An email from payroll@northbridge.co.pay-portal.io. Your November pay stub is ready. Sign in to view it.

snip-d3.text: An email from facilities@northbridge.co. The 3rd floor kitchen is closed Friday for cleaning. Use the 2nd floor kitchen instead.

snip-c1.text: An email from vpn@login-northbridge.help. Your VPN session expired. Re-enter your Northbridge username and password here to reconnect.

snip-c2.text: A phone call from "IT Helpdesk" (unknown number). "Hi, I am finishing your laptop setup remotely. What is your password so I can log in as you?"

snip-c3.text: A browser page from portal.northbridge.co (opened from your bookmark). You typed the portal address yourself. It asks you to sign in with single sign-on.

snip-g1.text: A text from "Your manager" (new number). Can you grab 4 gift cards for a client? Scratch them and text me photos of the codes. Will pay you back.

snip-g2.text: An email from ceo.dana.ortiz@gmail.com. Buy $500 in gift cards for the team raffle. Keep it a surprise, reimbursement tomorrow.

snip-g3.text: An email from people-team@northbridge.co. Thanks for finishing onboarding! Your coffee reward is in the HR portal under Rewards. Nothing to buy.

snip-a1.text: An email from scanner@northbridge-print.com. New scan from Floor 4 printer. Attachment: Scan_0042.pdf.exe

snip-a2.text: An email from tracking@parcel-notify.net. Your package could not be delivered. Open Shipping_Label.docm and click "Enable macros" to view.

snip-a3.text: A chat message from Marco Lee (your manager, northbridge.co). As promised in standup, I shared "Onboarding checklist" in our team folder on Northbridge Drive.

snip-m1.text: A sign-in prompt from Northbridge Authenticator. 2:14 AM. Approve sign-in? (12th request in 5 minutes) You are not signing in.

snip-m2.text: A text from an unknown number. Northbridge IT: reply with the 6-digit code we just sent to confirm your identity.

snip-m3.text: A sign-in prompt from Northbridge Authenticator. You just signed in on your laptop. Approve sign-in from "Your laptop, New York"? Number 42 matches your screen.

snip-o1.text: A social post from You (draft). First day at Northbridge! Close-up of my new badge and my desk screen with the login page open. #NewHire

snip-o2.text: A social message from "Recruiter Jamie" (no mutual connections). Love your profile! Who on your team approves vendor payments, and when is your manager traveling next?

snip-o3.text: A social post from You (draft). Excited to start as an analyst at Northbridge Co. this week! Grateful for the warm welcome.

snip-v1.text: A pop-up from "Northbridge Defender" browser pop-up. VIRUS DETECTED! Your laptop is locked. Call 1-888-555-0199 now for Northbridge Support.

snip-v2.text: In the lobby: USB stick found by the elevators. Label: "Salary review 2026". You plug it into your laptop to find the owner.

snip-v3.text: A system notice from Northbridge IT Software Center (installed app). Security update ready. Restart tonight to finish installing.

flag-u1.text: A 30-minute deadline plus a link that is not northbridge.co.

flag-u2.text: Rush plus secrecy from an outside domain.

flag-u3.text: Fine: a normal internal deadline, no link, no ask for data.

flag-d1.text: Look-alike domain: northbrigde.co swaps two letters.

flag-d2.text: The real owner is pay-portal.io; "northbridge.co" in front is decoration.

flag-d3.text: Fine: the real northbridge.co domain, no link, no ask.

flag-c1.text: A link asking for your password on a non-Northbridge site.

flag-c3.text: Fine: you opened the real portal yourself.

flag-g1.text: Gift cards plus codes over text from an unknown number.

flag-g2.text: An executive on a personal email asking for gift cards, kept secret.

flag-g3.text: Fine: nothing to buy, no codes to send, real sender.

flag-a2.text: "Enable macros" on a surprise document runs code.

flag-a3.text: Fine: an expected file in the drive you already use.

flag-m1.text: A flood of prompts you did not start is an attacker with your password.

flag-m2.text: Nobody legitimate asks you to send them your code.

flag-m3.text: Fine: you started it and the number matches.

flag-o1.text: A badge close-up and a screen shot help attackers copy or target you.

flag-o2.text: A stranger mapping who pays and when people are away.

flag-o3.text: Fine: no badge, no screen, no dates or places.

flag-v1.text: Scary pop-ups with a phone number are fake support scams.

flag-v2.text: Found USB sticks are a classic way to plant malware.

flag-v3.text: Fine: the real IT app, nothing to download from a link.

tip-urgency.text: Pressure to act right now is a red flag. Slow down and verify through a channel you already trust.

tip-lookalike.text: Read the sender domain letter by letter, from the right; northbridge.co is the only real one.

tip-credential.text: Never type your password from a link or give it to a caller. Open portals from your own bookmark.

tip-giftcard.text: Real managers never ask you to buy gift cards and send codes. Call them on a number you already have.

tip-attachment.text: Unexpected files, double extensions (.pdf.exe) and "enable macros" mean report, do not open.

tip-mfa.text: Only approve an MFA prompt you just triggered yourself. Never read or text a code to anyone.

tip-oversharing.text: Badges, screens, org charts and travel plans help attackers. Keep them off public posts and strangers.

tip-device.text: Install only from the IT Software Center, never plug in found USB sticks, and lock your laptop.

habit-u1.text: Safe habit: Slow down; check account notices in the IT portal yourself.

habit-u2.text: Safe habit: Confirm every payment request by calling the person on a known number.

habit-u3.text: Safe habit: Real deadlines point you to tools you already use.

habit-d1.text: Safe habit: Read the domain letter by letter before you click.

habit-d2.text: Safe habit: Read domains from the right; the last part is the owner.

habit-d3.text: Safe habit: Even on real mail, still check before entering any data.

habit-c1.text: Safe habit: Reconnect from the VPN app itself, never from an email link.

habit-c2.text: Safe habit: Hang up and call the helpdesk number on the intranet.

habit-c3.text: Safe habit: Bookmarks are the safe way into every portal.

habit-g1.text: Safe habit: Call your manager on their known number first.

habit-g2.text: Safe habit: Real raffles go through the People team, never your card.

habit-g3.text: Safe habit: The scam is being asked to BUY cards and send codes.

habit-a1.text: Safe habit: Report unexpected attachments; never run files from email.

habit-a2.text: Safe habit: Never enable macros on a file you did not expect.

habit-a3.text: Safe habit: Expected + known sender + company drive = fine.

habit-m1.text: Safe habit: Deny, then tell IT and change your password.

habit-m2.text: Safe habit: Codes are typed by you, into the real site, only.

habit-m3.text: Safe habit: Approve only prompts you just triggered.

habit-o1.text: Safe habit: Share the news, never the badge or screen.

habit-o2.text: Safe habit: Do not share org charts or travel plans with strangers.

habit-o3.text: Safe habit: Celebrate without the details attackers want.

habit-v1.text: Safe habit: Close the tab and use the IT portal for real help.

habit-v2.text: Safe habit: Hand found devices to security; never plug them in.

habit-v3.text: Safe habit: Install updates promptly; do not hit "later" forever.
